# polarstate

> Fast Aalen-Johansen state-occupancy estimates for Polars DataFrames

## Docs

### API Reference

#### Estimation
> Build an inspectable event table from time-to-event observations.

- [prepare_event_table](https://uriahf.github.io/polarstate/reference/prepare_event_table.html): Generate the full event table from raw ``times`` and ``reals`` data

#### Prediction
> Evaluate state-occupancy probabilities at fixed time horizons.

- [predict_aj_estimates](https://uriahf.github.io/polarstate/reference/predict_aj_estimates.html): Predict state-occupancy probabilities at ``fixed_time_horizons``
